text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Good morning. I've been waiting for you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you look refreshed. It seems like you had a good rest last night too.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Which must mean… we're both fully rejuvenated!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Taking a day off was apparently worthwhile after all! A wise choice, if I say so myself!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …I wonder if I've praised you a bit too much. But sometimes words of appreciation are necessary, no? Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems like she's trying to praise my schedule management skills… I'll just say it's the thought that counts.
